title: Racism: Norman Granz insisting on hotels and train service
summary: Humes says she has not had trouble with racism and wonders why. Norman Granz made hotels that excluded Black guests accept the JATP company and got the best train accommodations, and she saw no friction among performers.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand
